TELI:T_AggregatorSample.TELI:description: Crystal clock count. Used as a reference count in converting many of the counters presented in this telemetry space.

Reference count for block cause counters. Counts the number of 10us intervals during which PkgC entry was blocked at least once by any reason. To calculate percent blocked by a specific reason, divide corresponding block reason counter by this counter value.

Reference count for prevent cause counters. Counts the number of times PkgC entry was blocked at least once by any reason. To calculate percent blocked by a specific reason, divide corresponding prevent reason counter by this counter value.
